title: Aromatic Smoky Brazilian Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Brazilian dish featuring smoky sausage in a rich and mustardy broth, served over pillowy rice.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the brown mustard, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, and smoked paprika.
Return the sausage to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the stew over cooked rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
